Name: WAG-Style Bear Portraits
Author: AirynS
Description:
This mod does pretty much what it says in the overview - it changes the portraits for the secret woods bear to match the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/url]' shopkeepers and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist[/url]'s Rose. WAG and/or RatA are not required to use this mod.

It also adds two new portraits, $4 as a happy expression without the maple syrup and $5 as an angry expression, for any modders who might like to use them in events.

The mod has one config option, "Green Background", for whether or not you would like the portraits to have a green background similar to vanilla. Set to 'false' by default for compatibility with dialogue UI mods.

To install, simply extract the "[CP] WAG-Style Bear Portraits" folder and drop it into your Mods folder.
